analyst_view.overall: Early view: Elche, 18th under Martín Anselmi, host a Sevilla side 6th but inconsistent (one win in five). Elche had not won at home this season as of early November and need points badly. Thomas Lemar (Elche) and Peque (Sevilla) are expected back from injury by late November.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals. I lean lower: Elche have kept the ball under Anselmi but created little at home (they lost 0-1 to Valencia after a goalless first half), and earlier kept three clean sheets in four games.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.5 corners. I lean slightly higher: Anselmi wants an attacking, front-foot side, and in the Valencia game Elche had more of the ball and pushed hard late, which drives corners.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.0 cards. A relegation-threatened home side against a mid-table Sevilla fits this number, and with no referee named yet I stay with it.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.7 shots. Neither club is in Europe, so no rotation, and nothing in the news points either way.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.6 shots on target. I lean a little lower, in line with Elche's poor chance creation at home despite having more of the ball.
